channel.title: Kimani Upshur Daily Devotional
channel.description: A fresh Bible devotional every day from Kimani Upshur, M.Ed.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 1 Corinthians 15:58
item.description:
“Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.”

1 Corinthians 15:58 (KJV)

When serving God feels pointless, remember: nothing done for Him is wasted. Stay steady — it's all counting.

Prayer: Father, keep me steadfast in Your work.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Proverbs 2:6
item.description:
“For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.”

Proverbs 2:6 (KJV)

You do not have to figure everything out alone; wisdom is a gift God gives. Ask Him for it before you make that decision today. His mouth is the source of true understanding.

Prayer: Lord, give me Your wisdom for my decisions today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: John 14:1
item.description:
“Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.”

John 14:1 (KJV)

A troubled heart is a believing heart that forgot what it believes. Jesus' prescription is simple: believe in Him as you believe in God.

Prayer: Lord, calm my troubled heart; I believe in You.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Romans 14:19
item.description:
“Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.”

Romans 14:19 (KJV)

Don't just avoid conflict — actively chase peace. Build people up instead of tearing them down.

Prayer: Lord, make me a builder of peace today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 2 Corinthians 4:8-9
item.description:
“We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair; Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed.”

2 Corinthians 4:8-9 (KJV)

Paul was honest about pressure, but he refused to be crushed by it. Trouble may surround you, but it does not have the final word. You may be pressed, but you are not destroyed.

Prayer: Lord, when I am pressed, remind me I am not crushed.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Psalm 130:5
item.description:
“I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.”

Psalm 130:5 (KJV)

Waiting on God is active, not passive; it is hope anchored in His Word. While you wait for your answer, let Scripture be your hope. He is worth the wait.

Prayer: Lord, as I wait, my hope is in Your Word.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Romans 6:23
item.description:
“For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.”

Romans 6:23 (KJV)

Sin pays wages — death. But God offers a gift — eternal life. You can't earn a gift; you can only receive it.

Prayer: Father, thank You for the gift of eternal life.
